literal_meaning: মনের অন্তর বা মনের পার্থক্য (mind's difference or rift in heart/mind)
figurative_meaning_en: quarrel, mental discord or rift in relationship
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের মধ্যে মনান্তর হয়ে গেছে, আর কথা বলে না।
example_sentences_in_english: There is a rift between them; they don't talk anymore.
The discord between the siblings saddened everyone.
history: Derived as a pun from 'মতান্তর' (difference of opinion) to 'মনান্তর' (difference of mind), emphasizing emotional rather than intellectual disagreement.
note: This idiom plays on linguistic similarity in Bengali to highlight relational tensions.
